steps.title: 👋 Welcome
text: Welcome to the app! Let's get started with a quick tour.
This app has been designed as a way to generate sentences with random input you provided
We imported an example for you to fiddle around, don't be shy and try to Click everywhere 😀

steps.title: 📌 Quick tips
text: -In the left section you have words and @pouches that are used to generate sentence
-To add a word, click the + button in the Rundown section.
-Pouches are created by typing words starting with '@'.

steps.title: 🤿 In-depth Guide
text: Click here, the help button in the top right corner at any time for a detailed tutorial on all features.

steps.title: 🎲 GGenerate
text: When you are ready click on GGenerate ! to have your first result
